hotspots.title: Trump vs. Mainstream Media Conflict
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to restore White House access for several major news outlets, reversing a previous ban. The administration had defended the ban, arguing media access is a privilege, not a right.
hotspots.affect: This story commands disproportionate attention due to the direct clash over press freedom, constitutional rights, and the administration's power to control media access, eliciting strong reactions across the political spectrum.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes UN General Assembly Meetings
hotspots.blurb: President Trump addressed the UN General Assembly, simultaneously threatening Iran with 'annihilation' while also confirming 'very good' talks between the US and Iran. This mixed messaging created significant geopolitical tension.
hotspots.affect: The contradictory rhetoric of potential 'annihilation' alongside 'successful talks' regarding Iran at the UNGA creates high drama, alarm, and a sense of unpredictable international stakes.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes Xi Jinping Summit
hotspots.blurb: President Trump hosted Chinese leader Xi Jinping for a highly anticipated state visit, marked by a grand welcome and discussions on critical issues like trade. The summit aimed to strengthen bilateral relations amidst global challenges.
hotspots.affect: The extensive coverage of the 'high-stakes' nature, lavish diplomatic display, and crucial trade discussions signals significant national interest and investment in US-China relations.

hotspots.affect: This cluster of stories is charged with allegations of executive overreach, legal battles, and controversial policy decisions concerning healthcare and environmental regulations, sparking strong partisan contention.
